phase0.text: `bun loop` CLI: state, stage gates, plan changelog, evidence index
`bun loop migration <name>` claims the number and registers it in `db.ts`
`bun loop check` and `.github/workflows/check.yml` running it on every push and PR
`bun loop pr`, `pr-body restore|verify` around the loop markers
`bun loop evals`: G1–G10 twice on a fresh local DB, screenshots and videos
`[G3]` round-trip and `[G6]` picker flows tagged in `tools/e2e`, counts ratcheted in the baseline
Baseline taken from a green `bun loop evals` (evidence/strategy-loop)

items.notes: Loop scope: backup workflow and a restore drill against local Postgres. Owner steps: R2 and Neon secrets, first production dump, 5xx alert
Owner decisions on ADRs and licence
Needs a prospect's Data Usaha and consent

learnings.text: One writer for shared files (`app.ts`, `route-privileges.ts`, `db.ts`, migrations); migrations only via `bun loop migration`.
The PR body's loop section is rendered from state, so `/no-mistakes` overwriting it costs one `bun loop pr-body restore`.
